lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately three vertical columns with roughly 3-4 blobs per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible on the mid-flank, intersecting with the horizontal alignment of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to low luminance (shadow) on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated fish silhouettes (remoras) with distinct longitudinal striping are visible beneath the pectoral fin and along the ventral margin of the shark.
